aiOverview.content: Foul Play with Anthony Davis is a TBS prank show premiering April 6, 2026, where NBA star Anthony Davis pranks fellow athletes and celebrities. Executive produced by the team behind Impractical Jokers, the series features elaborate setups, including a premiere episode where Davis and LeBron James target Draymond Green with a fake $100M investment, and Jordan Chiles pranks Rickea Jackson. You can watch a sneak peek of the show in this video:02:14Entertainment TonightYouTube• Apr 3, 2026 Key Details for "Foul Play with Anthony Davis" Premise: Anthony Davis orchestrates high-stakes pranks on A-list athletes and sports stars. Release Date: The series premiered on April 6, 2026, on TBS, TNT, and truTV. Production: Executive produced by the creators of Impractical Jokers. Targeted Guests: Season 1 guests include LeBron James, Draymond Green, Rickea Jackson, and Jordan Chiles. How to Watch: Available on TBS, and can be streamed via services like DIRECTV (which offers a free trial), Sling, or Max. DIRECTV Episode Highlights Draymond Green Prank: LeBron James and Anthony Davis team up to trick Draymond Green with a fake business opportunity. Rickea Jackson Prank: Olympic gymnast Jordan Chiles tricks WNBA star Rickea Jackson in a "parking lot nightmare" scenario. The show is designed to showcase the lighter, chaotic side of professional athletes in the style of Impractical Jokers.
